scaling.interpretation: 18 illustrative cells, one seed per profile; profile effects are confounded with seed and bundled economic features. No factorial causal or population superiority claim. Universe size is distinct from held positions and effective corridor candidates.

external.transform: QIS point-in-time demeaned log-return EWMA, span 52, annualisation 52 model periods, artificial weekly labels, no future observations; synthetic cash variance 1e-6. Current holdings, target and every constraint are synthetic.
external.redistribution: Fetch original files from their owner; raw files and derived covariance arrays are excluded from the public archive until reuse terms are established. Public loader, source checksums and transformation suffice to regenerate locally.

accounting.order: Serial cases in declared order; rotate independent arms by case index. Each arm starts in a fresh process; no incumbent crosses arms.
accounting.cost: Charge common preparation to each arm, representation conversion separately, and method guidance/search/sizing to its engine time. Retain worker and process time including original-input audit, reporting and imports. Peak resident memory covers the entire worker, including reporting.
accounting.interruption: Kill only the study worker at its predeclared process ceiling; retain a failed-delivery record and any boundary result separately. Ranked defaults have no newly imposed internal stopping algorithm.
accounting.quality: Report paired feasible-incumbent TE, native absolute/relative gaps, first native accepted incumbent where available, runtime and failure denominators. An unfinished Exact incumbent is not a proven optimum; Kernel restricted bounds are not global bounds.
accounting.policy_domain: Full60 changes only the corridor policy domain, retaining hard rows and common mandatory preparation. This is not an algorithm comparison.
accounting.pilot: Exclude all four seed-2026102951 pilot cases from evaluation and headline statistics.
accounting.historical: Keep the previous 313-case OP 9.2.0 cohort unchanged and report separately.
